why: Extends guaranteed flux bounds to affine source equilibrium and higher-order H(div) structure.
Turns the earlier local P2 mathematics into a usable global higher-order discretization.
Uses enriched P2 dual solves so quantities of interest can drive refinement.
Generalizes guarantees to coefficient contrast, projected data, and mixed-boundary contracts.
Connects marking/refinement to the reviewed axioms-of-adaptivity framework.
Opens mixed Poisson, incompressibility, and constrained systems through Brezzi theory.
Adds eigenvalue inclusion and variational spectral infrastructure.
Extends CACE from stationary PDEs to stable time stepping and temporal residuals.
Adds exact discrete-complex structure and curl-curl nullspace auditing.
Unifies dependency graphs, evidence scope, reproducibility, and qualification.
